content.thinking: Found that CLOSE_DT stores the literal string 'NULL' instead of a true null, journals in periods 5 and 7 fall outside their period's date range, and no 'V' invoices exist. Next I'll test relationships and balance.

input.sql:
SELECT 'unbalanced_journals' k, count(*) c FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum("DR_AMT")<>sum("CR_AMT")) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_no_header', count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'headers_no_lines', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_bad_acct_exact', count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" a WHERE a."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD")
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_bad_acct_trim', count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" a WHERE trim(a."ACCT_CD")=trim(l."ACCT_CD"))
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_bad_vend_exact', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APVEND" v WHERE v."VEND_CD"=i."VEND_CD")
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_bad_vend_trim', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APVEND" v WHERE trim(v."VEND_CD")=trim(i."VEND_CD"))
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_bad_jrnl', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_null_jrnl', count(*) FROM "APINVH" WHERE "JRNL_NO" IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_bad_inv', count(*) FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'jh_bad_prd', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLPERD" p WHERE p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'jh_date_outside_prd', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE h."POST_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'jh_ref_notnull', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "REF_JRNL_NO" IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'jh_ref_dangling', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE "REF_JRNL_NO" IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" x WHERE x."JRNL_NO"=h."REF_JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'paid_inv_no_pay', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE "STAT_CD"='P' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'open_inv_with_pay', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE "STAT_CD"='O' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_sum_ne_inv', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i JOIN (SELECT "INV_ID", sum("PAY_AMT") s, count(*) n FROM "APPAYM" GROUP BY 1) p ON p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" WHERE p.s<>i."INV_AMT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'multi_pay_inv', count(*) FROM (SELECT "INV_ID" FROM "APPAYM" GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_inv_no_vendor', count(*) FROM (SELECT "VEND_CD","INV_NO" FROM "APINVH" GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_jrnl_hdr', count(*) FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNH" GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1) x
